en: {player}, forgive me for hurrying you off like that. But I had to thank you properly.
Wally's grown so much healthier since he went to Verdanturf. And it all began with the Pokémon you helped him catch.
That made him happier than I've seen him in years. And it made me happy too, as his father, that he has a friend like you.
It isn't much of a thank-you, but please take this.
HM03 holds Surf. A Pokémon that knows it can carry you over the water, to all sorts of places you couldn't reach before.
Ah, you must be {player}. Thank you for looking after our Wally earlier.
He's been frail since he was a baby, so we've sent him to my relatives in Verdanturf Town. The air there is much cleaner.
He's already set off, you see. I wonder how far he's got by now?
I wonder how our Wally is getting on.
Wally will be coming home soon. I can hardly wait.
Wally was so happy when he told us he'd caught a Pokémon. I hadn't seen him smile like that in ages.
Don't tell my husband, but Wally has gone off from Verdanturf without a word to anyone.
He's frail, but he's stubborn too. I'm sure he'll come home safe and sound one day.
